description: Current state of the incubator, as published by the digital twin: the latest sensor readings, actuator settings, filtered state estimate, controller settings, calibrated model parameters, and the batch's progress through fermentation.

controller.comment: lower_bound_c is an offset below temperature_desired_c, not an absolute temperature: heating starts when the air falls to temperature_desired_c - lower_bound_c. There is no upper bound setting; the controller stops heating on a timer, not on a temperature.

model_parameters.source: Four-parameter calibration of this incubator, fitted with the box empty and the lid closed. A loaded box has more thermal mass than C_air represents.
model_parameters.comment: Real calibrated four-parameter values from the vendored DT, copied verbatim. P_heater = V_heater * I_heater = 18.665 W.

lid_disturbance.source: Seven-parameter calibration of this incubator (the physically valid parameter set; the set distributed by default has a negative heater capacitance and must not be used).
lid_disturbance.comment: While the lid is open the box's heat loss coefficient rises from G_box to G_open_lid: power_out_box = ((1 - lid_open) * G_box + lid_open * G_open_lid) * (T - T_room). G_open_lid was calibrated alongside a different G_box (0.694) and a different heater power than model_parameters above, so its absolute value does not transfer. Apply g_open_lid_ratio to the G_box in use instead.
lid_disturbance.validated_against: Not validated against a recorded opening. The one comparison made against real data measured an open-lid time constant of about 50.6 s, against the 21.5 s this ratio implies, so an open lid is modelled as cooling the box faster than it does. Predictions made with it are therefore conservative.

fermentation.notes: The batch's phase is not sensed. It is derived from elapsed_hours against the taxonomy in domain_knowledge/tempeh_thresholds.json, together with the safe temperature band that applies to it. The boundary between the lag and active-growth phases reflects a 22 hour run in which self-heating became strong enough after about 11.3 hours that the setpoint was lowered and the heater stayed off for the rest of the batch.
